Very fulfilling meal with smiling faces to greet
May 2026 • Friends
Food

1. Grilled Prawn Salad
The salad was fresh, crunchy and full of vitality and vigour. The dressing was perfect and the prawns were succulent and sweet. Highly recommended.
2. Paccheri Pesto and Burrata
The al dente pasta with the pesto was very appetizing. The pesto sauce was a drool worthy! The bright basil green creamy sauce is definitely worth a try.
3. Truffle Alfredo pasta 
Good to have, the smell is more than the flavor in the food but definitely worth a try 
4. Mango soda was a bit on the sweeter side and less soda so could skip 

Service 
Fantastic service. The staff were very courteous and helpful. Linh was especially super helpful and smiling. 

Ambience 
The place is in the mall so humble but better than most in the good court. It’s tastefully made for the location.

Hello! 

Thank you so much for taking the time to share such a detailed and thoughtful review of your dining experience with us.

It is wonderful to know you enjoyed the freshness of our **Grilled Prawn Salad** and found the creamy, bright flavors of our **Paccheri Pesto and Burrata** to be so appetizing. We also appreciate your constructive feedback regarding the balance of the Truffle Alfredo and the sweetness of the Mango Soda, as this helps our culinary team continuously refine our menu.

We will be sure to pass your special praise along to **Linh**! She will be delighted to hear that her helpful service and bright smile made your visit stand out. While we are located within the mall, we are so glad you found our space tastefully designed and more comfortable than the typical food court setting.

Thank you again for your recommendations, and we hope to welcome you back for another satisfying meal soon!

Disappointed and sneaky
Apr 2026 • Solo
The service and fries were excellent, and I really appreciated the friendly staff. However, I was disappointed with the truffle chicken Diana. For 600,000 VND, I expected a higher-quality cut of meat, such as chicken breast, but it was made with darker meat instead. The flavor was okay, but the choice of cut didn’t match the price point.

And a service charge was added without my permission.
It would have been good to let me decide what I’d like to tip

Staff was great
Read more
Written April 29, 2026
Bono Yel
Hello and thank you for taking the time to share your feedback with us. We are truly pleased to hear that our staff made such a positive impression on you and that you enjoyed our fries and the overall service.

Regarding the Truffle Chicken Diane, we appreciate your feedback on the cut of meat. We specifically select boneless corn-fed chicken leg for this recipe because it provides a juicier and more flavorful experience compared to chicken breast. We list these specific details on our menu to help our guests choose the dish that best fits their preferences. The menu price for this dish is 399,000 VND.

In relation to the service charge and tax, we aim for complete transparency by including a note on every page of our menu stating that prices do not include these additions. A 5% service charge is a standard practice across many restaurants and hotels in Vietnam, but we certainly regret if this felt unexpected during your visit. If would like to get return service charge fee and chicken Diane, kindly contact us via Facebook Fanpage message, we happy to return as you wish. 

Your comments are very important to us as we strive to provide the best possible experience for our guests. We hope to have the opportunity to welcome you back for a meal that fully meets your expectations in the future.

Best Regards from Truffle & Team and Looking forward to seeing you Soon.
